True from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Uniform full rows and columns are the tile separators.
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds) - 1):
        r0, r1 = row_bounds[ri] + 1, row_bounds[ri + 1]
        if r0 >= r1:
            continue
        row_out = []
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds) - 1):
            c0, c1 = col_bounds[ci] + 1, col_bounds[ci + 1]
            if c0 >= c1:
                continue
            vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)]
            bg = Counter(vals).most_common(1)[0][0]
            noise_count = sum(v != bg for v in vals)
            row_out.append(1 if noise_count == 2 else bg)
        out.append(row_out)
    return out
